_comment: Classification of never-varying observation dim GROUPS (see check_dim_exercise.py for status semantics and the group-key collapsing rules). Keys match by prefix against collapsed feature names. Order matters: first match wins, so specific keys go before broad ones.

learn_move/offered/type_onehot[.reason: type one-hot bank of the offered move — one lane per offered-move type; bank reviewed as a unit (layout canary + goldens)

learn_move/party_index[.reason: learner party-index one-hot — lane per party slot; which lane lights depends on who levels

learn_move/.reason: v9 block: offered-move feature scalars vary with WHICH move is offered; a single corpus learn-move scenario lights only that move's features. Block liveness gated separately (nonzero at learn_move decisions).

active-slot/move_effectiveness.reason: the game nulls turn_data.moveEffectiveness at MoveEffectPhase end, before any decision point (move-effect-phase.ts ~900); see UNSOLVED.md U8

active-slot/is_mega.reason: needs a mega evolution: the STARTING_MODIFIER_OVERRIDE bracelet scenario crashes during the title flow (getBattlerCount on null battle) — mid-run bracelet acquisition not scripted yet

active-slot/is_max.reason: needs dynamax — same situation as is_mega

bench-slot/stat_stages[.reason: stat stages reset on switch-out; a benched mon's stages are always 0

bench-slot/move_queue_len.reason: move queues only exist for on-field mons

bench-slot/hit_count.reason: battle-data accumulates while fielded; stays 0 for never-fielded bench in short runs

bench-slot/is_boss.reason: a benched boss requires catching a boss Pokemon; not scripted

bench-slot/is_terastallized.reason: tera state clears on switch-out/faint in classic flow

bench-slot/toxic_turn_count.reason: requires a badly-poisoned mon to be switched out (toxic persists); status corpus uses active mons

bench-slot/sleep_turns_remaining.reason: requires a sleeping mon switched to bench

shop/shop[]/.reason: shop slots 4-5: the shop only offers 5-6 options at higher wave tiers than the current longest scenario (~35 waves) reaches

phase_onehot[mystery.reason: Mystery Encounters are PERMANENTLY disabled: applyOverrideValues (apply-overrides.ts) forces MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_RATE_OVERRIDE=0 and refuses BATTLE_TYPE_OVERRIDE=MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER on every transport, so no override can re-enable them; the mystery phase one-hot can never fire

phase_onehot[.reason: rare decision phases (evolution/form_change/revival_blessing/select_biome: occurrence depends on party/run length; learn_move/target appear in smoke runs)

battle/.reason: non-classic game-mode flags (is_endless/is_daily/is_challenge/has_random_*/inverse_battle) and special battle specs require other game modes; corpus is classic-only

field/.reason: weather/terrain one-hot cells and per-side arena tag cells vary only when that exact weather/terrain/tag occurs; bank correctness is pinned by semantic tests (arena-tags-sides, weather-terrain) and goldens

inventory/.reason: held/party/lapsing/enemy modifier feature cells vary with the specific items held; bank correctness pinned by held-items semantic tests, goldens and live parity

derived/.reason: type-effectiveness/STAB cells for move x enemy combinations not seen in the corpus; computation pinned by type-effectiveness semantic tests

shop/reward[]/.reason: reward option tier/feature cells depend on which items roll; covered by shop-state semantic test + parity

shop/header/.reason: header cells (reroll cost ratio bands) vary with money/waves; covered by parity

active-slot/.reason: remaining active-slot cells are one-hot/flag-bank members (types, tera, status, ability/passive feature cells, rare move flags like is_ohko/transforms_into_target) that need the specific species/move/ability to appear; banks are pinned by semantic tests, golden fixtures and 3000+-state live parity

bench-slot/.reason: same as active-slot/ for bench positions
